results.description:
Welcome to Mysthaven… where magic is real, secrets run deep, and even misfits belong.

Autumn Waverly, a siren who can't sing, runs a cozy bar called The Siren's Song in the only town she's ever loved. Mysthaven may be full of supernatural residents, but Autumn's life has always been comfortably predictable… until a handsome shifter who can't shift walks into her bar.

Minutes later, one of her customers turns up dead.

With suspicion swirling and whispers spreading through town, Autumn teams up with her found family of magical oddballs, including Penny, her sharp-tongued talking cat (who insists she's actually a dragon), to uncover the truth before the killer strikes again. But Mysthaven has a way of hiding its darkest secrets in plain sight, and danger may be closer than anyone expects.

Caught between a growing attraction she didn't plan on, a town worth protecting, and a mystery that threatens everything she holds dear, Autumn must discover who she really is… and why that matters more than ever.

A Siren's Song is the first book in a cozy paranormal mystery series filled with warmth, magic, found family, and a community ready to fight for what they love.
